solves.reasoning: (A) effective - parallel with efficient, positive quality. (B) convey - context about communicating data. (C) pushing - pushing material out of presentation.
(A) oral - contrasted with 'written report'. (B) detailed - 'lots of' + technical facts context. (C) handout - parallel with 'document', something to distribute.
(A) personally - meeting individuals who are interested. (B) conclusions - presentations draw out key conclusions. (C) elsewhere - directing audience to other sources.
withhold(보류하다) doesn't fit - context is about wanting to communicate/convey data, not withhold it. Original: convey.
cover up(감추다) doesn't fit - should be draw out(이끌어 내다). Covering up conclusions is opposite to the passage's intent.
neglect(무시하다) doesn't fit - passage says make them feel you care about them. Neglect is the opposite of care.
into a __ or a document - something to put material into, parallel with document. handout = 유인물.
offer to meet personally __ - meeting after the presentation ends. afterwards = 나중에, 그 뒤에.
find the extra detail __ - directing to other places/sources. elsewhere = 다른 곳에서.
efficient(효율적인) ≈ productive(생산적인). Both relate to achieving results without waste.
detailed(상세한) ≈ thorough(철저한). Both mean comprehensive and covering all aspects.
raw(가공하지 않은) ≈ unprocessed(미가공의). Both describe data/material in its natural state.
effective(효과적인) ↔ futile(헛된). Futile means having no result/effect, direct opposite.
oral(구두의) ↔ written(서면의). The passage itself contrasts oral presentation vs written report.
(A) oral examination = 구두 시험 (face to face questions). (B) oral medication = 경구 약물 (taken by mouth).
'to make ideas, feelings, or information known to someone' = convey(전달하다). Conceal is opposite, acquire/abandon unrelated.
as effective or __ - or connects parallel adjectives. efficiency(명사) → efficient(형용사).
their __ - possessive + noun slot. needy(형용사) → needs(명사 복수). Context: them and their needs.
key conclusions or __ - parallel structure, both are key takeaways from a presentation. take-home messages fits perfectly.
Alternatively, __ personally afterwards - suggesting meeting people interested in details. offer to meet = 만나겠다고 제안.
